connector.name: Kafka Sentinel
connector.registryDescription: Read-only Kafka observability MCP server: cluster health, consumer lag, and replay-readiness.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package kafka-sentinel-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sanjay-amu account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
